question: Which of the following banks has signed a loan of $40 million to Northern Arc Capital to support the microfinance borrowers and the MSME sectors in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ADB.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Asian Development Bank (ADB) signed a $40 million__ loan to Northern Arc Capital Limited (NACL) to support the livelihoods of microfinance borrowers and MSMEs in India.
 
• The loan is disbursed to NACL as part of ADB's ongoing COVID-19 response.
 
• NACL will on-lend the loan proceeds and provide guarantees to financial institutions and individual borrowers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ADB:

 
 
• Headquarters - Mandaluyong, Philippines.
 
• President - Masatsugu Asakawa. (Feb 2022)
 
• Founded On - 19 December 1966.
